metadata.title: On the second smallest ideal right-angled hyperbolic four-polytope
metadata.abstract: The regular ideal right-angled 24-cell has volume $4 \pi^2/3$ and is the unique minimum-volume entirely ideal right-angled hyperbolic four-polytope. We prove that the next distinct volume is $8 \pi^2/3$ and that its unique equality case is the reflection double of the 24-cell across one octahedral facet. We also show that an entirely ideal right-angled four-polytope whose facets are regular ideal octahedra or their doubles across triangular faces decomposes into a chain of regular 24-cells, with opposite cutting facets in each intermediate cell.

analysis.progressType: 双曲多胞体的次小体积与等号
analysis.workSummary: 在完全理想直角双曲四维多胞体中，已知正24胞体是唯一最小体积者；作者证明下一个不同体积为8π²/3，唯一等号模型是沿一个八面体面反射加倍的24胞体。另对面仅为正理想八面体或其沿三角面加倍者，证明可分解成24胞体链。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出最小值之后的尖锐体积间隙和唯一性，并识别特定面类型下的整体拼接结构。
analysis.limitations: 完全理想、直角、四维均不可删除；链分解另有面类型前提，中间24胞体的切割面须相对。不是任意双曲四维多胞体的次小体积分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确使用GPT-6-astra、GPT-6.1-sol作研究及代码助手，探索证明想法、加强结果、改善表述，并生成及审查Python和Lean4代码。具体AI使用来自声明，不是Lean本身；泛指加强结果未明确归因特定核心构造，故不标ideas。
